label: Electricity prices for non-household consumers - bi-annual data

label.MWH20-499: Consumption from 20 MWh to 499 MWh - band IB

label.MWH2000-19999: Consumption from 2 000 MWh to 19 999 MWh - band ID
label.MWH20000-69999: Consumption from 20 000 MWh to 69 999 MWh - band IE

extension.description: Bi-annual statistics on real invoiced electricity prices charged to final non-household (industrial) consumers, classified by annual consumption bands IA–IG and by three tax levels, in line with Eurostat methodology and Regulation (EU) 2016/1952.
